scope: Independent read-only calculations and code/report review; only this audit artifact was written with parent authorization. No network, model fits, production changes or Git mutations.

frozen_selection_reconciliation.method: Independently read baseline date/ticker identities and six frozen NumPy score arrays. Confirm source digests, row-identity hashes, array position, date/ticker/score match, score equals the maximum for that date, and training_end precedes every selected date. Read each saved live signal file and match each selected rank.
frozen_selection_reconciliation.limitation: Research variants share dates; 684 memberships are not 684 independent dates. This check does not certify immutable original publication of live files or make the research prospective.

source_integrity_reconciliation.method: Rehashed every referenced minute source and daily source; checked minute identity and raw basis, daily anchor payload identity/date/basis, and verified-alias artifact hashes. Result source hashes and compressed-case hashes match current bytes.
source_integrity_reconciliation.provider_alias: MOG-B maps to MOG.B with dated identity evidence. Raw daily payload.symbol remains MOG.B. The unavailable prior daily reference is not fabricated.
source_integrity_reconciliation.common_credential_pattern_scan: No API-key query values, bearer credentials, or common secret-token formats detected in study artifacts. This is a pattern scan, not a guarantee about arbitrary unknown secret formats.

independent_raw_case_reconciliation.method: Separate inline standard-library implementation loaded raw minute/daily sources; did not import or call analyze.py. Recomputed every event and checkpoint scenario from frozen bounds, source-quality rules, anchors, completed-bar signals, exact next-minute opens and expected final-minute closes.
independent_raw_case_reconciliation.fields_checked: Availability and source status/reason, signal/dip state, signal timestamp/close/depth, entry timestamp/price, entry anchor return, exit price, zero-expense return, observed further downside, matched-open return, first observed threshold crossing, opening-gap flag, current observed episode, recovery flag, and dip ages.

summary_reconciliation.method: Independently aggregate counts, unique stock-days/dates, missing reasons, wins/losses/flats, means, medians, worst returns, observed downside and known-opportunity denominators for every reported event, timing/depth and checkpoint group.

uncertainty_reconciliation.method: Independent week-bucket implementation sampled complete ISO calendar weeks with fixed seed 20261109 and 2000 draws. Eight primary before-noon mean intervals were recomputed. All 104 comparison groups were checked; all 73 reported joint-week intervals and suppressed-interval conditions matched.
uncertainty_reconciliation.scope_limit: Mean uncertainty intervals outside the eight primary before-noon groups were reviewed in code, not separately recomputed. Reported intervals are descriptive and pointwise, not causal or multiplicity-adjusted evidence.

independent_cached_daily_check.interpretation: Cached Yahoo within-day ratio independently corroborates the large daily decline. The approximately 90-fold historical price scale matches the later recorded reverse split; no cross-provider rescaling or replacement is applied to the study.

qh_2025_07_28_tail_case.split_metadata_check: No recorded split crosses 2025-07-25 < execution_date <= 2025-07-28. The retained QH split event is a 1-for-90 reverse split on 2025-08-25.
qh_2025_07_28_tail_case.limits: Corroboration of the daily decline does not independently verify each minute price or a tradeable personal fill. Official daily close differs from the final-minute proxy. The separately unresolved April 2026 QH price-basis issue remains unresolved; this July check is not a ticker-wide certification. Split metadata does not certify all corporate actions.

outlier_contribution_diagnostic.purpose: Additive contribution to the unchanged primary before-noon mean; not a proposed exclusion or alternative optimized result.

reviewed_report: README.md correctly distinguishes Rank1 and lower ranks, research and saved live histories, entry versus onset, opening gaps, zero expense, exact missing boundaries, model input counts, proxy exits and observational uncertainty.
remaining_limitations: 09:35 ET ranking availability is an explicit user-directed assumption after the opening price; first publication is not independently proven for each saved file.
Minute OHLC values are price observations, not guaranteed executable broker fills. No trading expense was subtracted.
Source completeness relies partly on legacy archive contracts where original response pages were not retained; no new request was made in this review.
Sparse intermediate minutes only identify observed dips and observed further downside; they do not certify an unobserved path.
Exchange session bounds are frozen from the existing repository calendar and covered by focused half-day/DST tests; no second calendar provider was queried.
Current-universe survivorship, incomplete corporate-action/security-history certification and the prior research process limit economic and prospective interpretation.
All claims are descriptive. No early-time premium, best-time rule, causal effect or automatic buy instruction is established.
